title: Uniform Tor bound for compactly supported direct images
statement: Work in the standing scheme setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: $k$ is a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\ell\ne p$ is prime, and $X,Y$ are separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism, separated of finite type, whose geometric fibres have dimension at most $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $A$ be a finite commutative discrete ring killed by a power of $\ell$, regarded as the constant coefficient ring on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use $\Dctf$ and Tor amplitude as in [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], with the finite discrete comparison of [det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian]. For integers $a\leq b$, if $M\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$, then $Rf_!M\in\Dctf(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ has Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d]$. Here $Rf_!$ is the compactification functor $Rp_*j_!$ for $f=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification], on the etale-origin objects specified by the comparison. In particular, fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. If a coefficient tower $C_\bullet$ has levels $C_n\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)$, $n\geq1$, of common Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], then the levels of $Rf_{!,\bullet}C_\bullet$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] have common Tor amplitude $[a,b+2d]$ and cohomology vanishing outside that same interval.

proof.text: For a finite coefficient ring A, use finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin to obtain a bounded constructible small-etale antecedent of M. Compare the two ordinary derived comparison functors by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and their D+ restrictions by mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompatibility. The interval theorem comparison_torAmplitudeIn_iff gives this antecedent the original interval [a,b]. Choosing this antecedent occurs only within the theorem proof; no definition chooses data from a mere existence theorem.

Use the already proved source nonempty_iso_tensor_singleFunctor_obj_rightDerivedLowerShriek in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.CompactSupport. It specializes hasProjectionFormula_of_finite to an arbitrary degree-zero test sheaf N, using exact inverse image. Thus Rf_!K tensor N is isomorphic to Rf_!(K tensor f^*N). The Tor-amplitude definition directly puts the latter input in [a,b]; no flat representative, K-flatness proof or geometric-stalk calculation is needed here. The source compact-support formula composes the finite proper projection theorem and the open tensor comparison.

For the tensor input B, use source isGE_rightDerivedLowerShriek_obj to preserve the lower bound a. Apply source DerivedCategory.isLE_obj_of_isLE with d replaced by 2d to extend the sheaf bound lem-dg-compact-support-amplitude to B in degrees at most b+2d. These proved source lemmas are finite truncation inductions. Compare the chosen compactifications only on D+ using rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusιIso. Hence every test tensor of Rf_!K has cohomology in [a,b+2d]. All dimensions are those of the original fibres of f.

Construct the invertible-annihilator instance from l^r=0 in A, l nonzero in k and the map k to the global sections of Spec k. Apply the already proved source boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerShriek in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.DirectImage. That theorem implements exact constructible open extension followed by proper bounded constructible image; translate its cohomological constructibility predicate using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff. Obtain output cohomological vanishing by testing Tor amplitude against the tensor unit.

Identify the recorded ringed open-extension functor with sfIntrinsicDerivedOpen by uniqueness of left adjoints, using openSquarePullbackModel. Use the existing public proEtaleUnitLerayDirectImageIso to identify the two underived pushforwards; its proof is the adjunction hom-equivalence round trip for the coefficient map. Derive these isomorphisms and compose with etaleOriginOpenExtensionComparison and etaleOriginOpenDirectImageComparison on the bounded-below antecedent. This identifies the recorded compact-support output with the intrinsic realization of the etale output. Transport constructibility, Tor amplitude and cohomological vanishing through these isomorphisms and the finite-ring comparison.

At tower index n the coefficient ring is O_E/(l^(n+1)). It is finite by the existing positive-level instance; its annihilation by l^(n+1) follows immediately from Ideal.pow_mem_pow and the quotient criterion. Apply the finite-ring result with unchanged a,b,d to the n-th level. The existing SpTowerShriek.Fcomparison, followed by the open-coordinate isomorphism, identifies the output level with that finite compact-support output. Transport the Tor interval and cohomological vanishing along this isomorphism. No normalization assumption, new transition maps, or choice of a uniformizer is required.
